debate.name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd

rounds.text: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd trades at a P/E of just 23.9 [E1] despite displaying elite financial quality that vastly outperforms sector benchmarks, highlighted by an exceptional ROE of 30.3% [E13] compared to the sector benchmark of 11.94% [E9], and a staggering ROCE of 40.1% [E12] against a sector median of just 6.1% [E65]. This stellar profitability is underpinned by robust compounding, with 5-year compounded sales growth at 30% [E14] and profit growth reaching 41% [E17], alongside a pristine balance sheet that keeps the company almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02x [E31, E50] and healthy free cash flow generation of ₹ 166 Cr [E29]. Furthermore, intrinsic valuation models reveal a substantial margin of safety of 41.3% [E39] based on a DCF value of ₹ 446 per share [E38], while the reverse DCF indicates that the current market price of ₹ 262 [E2] only requires a modest 10.7% earnings growth against a base-case assumption of 18.0% [E40]. Conceded: institutional money flow reads negative with a holding change of -1.27 percentage points [E37], and domestic institutions decreased their stake by 3.14 percentage points [E36].
